'''Silas Yun'weah''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was part of the Imperial strike team during the events of the [[Conquest of Makeb]] acting as a supply officer for the science team responsible for mining the planet's core and the detachment of [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]].
